name: Calgary Expo
blurb: A four-day, family-friendly Fan Expo HQ show at Stampede Park in Calgary, with celebrity guests, anime, gaming, comics and a big cosplay program.

editions.evidence: Homepage JSON-LD Event 'CALGARY EXPO' 2027-04-22 -> 2027-04-25 @ Stampede Park, matching the visible countdown banner 'APRIL 22 - 25, 2027 STAMPEDE PARK'.

notes: Calgary Expo's own domain now redirects to fanexpohq.com/calgaryexpo/ (same Fan Expo HQ / Informa network as the other FEHQ shows). All of its guest pages (Celebrities, Comic Creators, and by the same template Animation Voices/Anime Guests/Gaming Stars/Cosplayers) are headed 'PAST FAN FAVE GUESTS INCLUDED', explicitly showcasing previous years' highlights (e.g. Elijah Wood, Sean Astin, William Shatner on Celebrities; Greg Capullo, Joe Quesada, Amanda Conner on Comic Creators) rather than a confirmed 2027 lineup, consistent with the show still being ~200 days out; no names were picked as guests for that reason. og:image is literally filenamed 'CE-Web-Placeholder', so the site's own logo is used for cover instead.
